description: Engineering pressure-test envelope for nominal local state-feedback baselines. Perturbation magnitudes are deliberate design probes, not measured Forest D1 specimen uncertainty bounds.
scope: simulation-only robustness characterization; no specimen calibration and no physical actuator authority

evaluation.basis: current project balance-entry envelope (8 deg, 1 rad/s); used here only as a common recovery classifier

scenarios.rationale: Separately identifiable baseline using the same 5 deg local initial condition as rotary_balance.toml.
Larger but still local upright-angle displacement pressure test.
Mirrored upright-angle displacement checks sign symmetry and recovery.
Bounded incoming pendulum-rate pressure test near upright.
Checks arm-position regulation without changing the pendulum coordinate convention.
Plus/minus 10 percent is an engineering pressure-test magnitude, not a measured mass tolerance.
Mirrors the mass pressure test to expose asymmetric controller margin.
Perturbs gravity leverage and coupling without claiming installed-specimen COM uncertainty.
Perturbs rotational inertia independently from mass/COM for structural sensitivity.
Damping is especially specimen-dependent; 0.5x is only a pressure test, not a tolerance claim.
A bounded additive plant disturbance tests recovery without hiding the cause inside controller authority.
Explicitly reduces the simulation control-torque bound to 50 percent as a capability pressure test; not a measured hardware limit.
